text:
carmen: quick design check — uploaded updated mock for the Rules Builder: compact rows, drag handle on the left, priority chip on the right, and a new 'Preview' panel that runs 10 sample requests. need quick feedback on ordering affordance, validation copy, and a11y notes. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/rules-builder

alex: looks cleaner. two quick things: 1) drag handle hit target feels small on touch — can we bump to 24px? 2) keyboard reorder? users should be able to move rules with keyboard arrows or explicit buttons (aria-grabbed alone isnt sufficient).

sam: preview is neat but be careful — running 10 live calls on every preview will eat into rate limits and skew metrics. can we use cached/synthetic samples or an opt-in live preview? also +1 to inline validation under the rule row instead of toasts; toasts vanish and are easy to miss during editing.

joel: copy nit — 'Simulate traffic' feels like load testing. options: 'Preview routing outcomes' or 'Preview sample responses'. also validation should be explicit: eg 'Missing route target — add a model or fallback'. users appreciate remediation steps.

aria: a11y notes: priority chips fail color contrast at smallest sizes (AA). recommend stronger contrast or an outline pattern. drag handle needs aria-label like 'move rule' and keyboard accessible controls (move up/move down buttons) for users who cant drag. preview results must render into a role='status' aria-live='polite' region so screen readers get updates.

ui-test-bot: e2e report: keyboard reordering test failing on CI (chrome-headless). stacktrace shows focus loss when reordering with handle. created RN-4321 and linked test logs: https://ci.internal/runs/9876

carmen: thanks all — plan: increase handle target, add visible move up/down buttons, switch preview to cached examples by default and make live run opt-in, move validation inline with explicit remediation copy, and add aria-live/status for preview. will post updated figma and a short prototype in ~3 hours. :thumbsup:
